name: wormwood
lore_descriptor: bone-pale, dense as ivory, with a faint smell of old steel
unidentified_descriptor: an unnaturally heavy length of wood
first_pickup_chronicle: Wormwood. Not the herb, the tree, grown on an old battlefield where the soil got very rich. Dense as bone. Won't burn, won't bend.
design_notes: Band E heavy rare_wood. Mult 1.30, weight 1.3, enchant 1. Rot-proof + bone-dense flavor. Closes the late-band wood gap so clubs/staves/bows have a heavy late-game option.
